storyInfo: Alita Valueva, director of Lab Six, investigates the truth behind Zelgrad's recruitment of the Infected. The guards watching the arrested Infected group allow them to escape. Tonya helps the Doctor when the Rhodes Island team encounters soldiers while trying to get into the secret area. Closure stays behind to help her.

attributes.content: <p=1>Zelgrad Sealed District Laboratory</><p=2> Jan 21, 1102, 07:21</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: ...I'm afraid I have to stop you.
attributes.name: Lab Director

attributes.content: The Marshal has ordered strict secrecy over New Lab Six's research. Even an inspection of research progress—
attributes.name: Lab Director

attributes.content: You are Alita Valueva? Director of this lab?
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: ...Yes, sir.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Then you know that the Marshal has given her son, Anatoliy Svetlanov, full authority over the Kushkina Project.
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: And you must know that the Generalik has reached the end of his patience with your lack of progress.
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: I have already explained to the Marshal that energy supplies have been highly inconsistent since the beginning of the Originium vein crisis.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: As the research progresses, its demand for energy grows... just as one cannot make butter from water, experiments cannot continue without the right conditions.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: On the unauthorized transfer of energy—
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: That is exactly what I'm trying to say—
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I've submitted a report on the matter to the Marshal, and personally overseen the shutdown of potential channels. It will not happen again.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Please explain it to the Generalik. I would be happy to submit a copy of the report for the Marshal to him.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Ah... I'm sure he would be very interested.
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: The Generalik's temperament is unlike the Marshal's. He wants to see New Lab Six's effectiveness and loyalty.
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: See those in your husband's lab, for example... the smallest of leaks has already ensured that they will never have the trust of the First Army again.
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: Do not repeat their mistakes.
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: Give her the letter.
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: Yes, sir.
attributes.name: Accompanying Soldier

attributes.content: Sir, this is...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Data provided by a friend of the Marshal's. The Generalik has instructed me to give it to you, so that the lab can improve upon Kushkina according to the concepts contained within.
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: Also, the test animal on the loose is causing panic amongst some of the civilians. The Generalik would like you to resolve this matter immediately, or at the very least find out the cause... do you understand?
attributes.name: Arrogant Officer

attributes.content: Alita takes a deep breath. Her fingers touch the letter sealed with Grypherburg's standard Hippogryph seal, and nods without hesitation, suppressing her doubts.
I understand... please tell the Generalik that I will do my duty and complete the goals as quickly as possible.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Phew—
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: They're gone. You can come out now.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Thank you, professor. They would have been suspicious if they saw me.
attributes.name: Ursus Researcher

attributes.content: I'm the one who should thank you, Marat.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: You're taking a huge risk, helping me look for data while acting as the Army's science consultant. I don't know how to thank you.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I'm not just doing it for you. I'm curious why they're suddenly recruiting so many Infected all of a sudden, myself.
attributes.name: Ursus Researcher

attributes.content: Did you find anything?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Ursus Researcher

attributes.content: They're using those Infected to provide 'energy' for the project.
attributes.name: Ursus Researcher

attributes.content: Are you saying—
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: In the literal sense of the word.
attributes.name: Ursus Researcher

attributes.content: Passphrase.
attributes.name: Duty Soldier

attributes.content: 'Snow made from iron does not burn.'
attributes.name: Delivering Soldier

attributes.content: You're three minutes late. Be careful next time. The ones inside are not as well-tempered as we are.
attributes.name: Duty Soldier

attributes.content: Not much we can do about it. There are fewer and fewer usables, and harder to acquire the goods. The higher-ups would rather those who are in less serious condition keep working.
attributes.name: Delivering Soldier

attributes.content: They'll come down on us if quota's not met.
attributes.name: Duty Soldier

attributes.content: We should worry about ourselves. We'll end up like those in the truck if we get infected ourselves.
attributes.name: Delivering Soldier

attributes.content: What's that sound—
attributes.name: Duty Soldier

attributes.content: Huh? I didn't hear anything.
attributes.name: Delivering Soldier

attributes.content: Well, it's about time this old bucket got an overhaul.
attributes.name: Delivering Soldier

attributes.content: Keep moving, don't waste time.
attributes.name: Duty Soldier

attributes.content: <p=1>The Walls, City of Zelgrad</><p=2> Jan 21, 1102, 09:03</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Phew... that was close!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I can't get any closer with all that jamming... not after I almost lost No.128.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Let me see... no, there's too much noise.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The drones start acting up within about 1km of this area. They can still fly, but real-time video is inoperable, and other preloaded functions are also disabled.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: There's something really weird about this wall!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Before the Rhodes Island team lies a tall, grey wall that stretches as far as the eye could see. The marks that rain has left upon it glow metallic blue under the grey skies.
Closure looks up at the wall that blocks out half the sky. Its size and weight is oppressive, even at a distance.
Good thing the patrols don't come around here, and we haven't seen any other locals approach. Do they all pretend the wall doesn't exist?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: It stretches out from downtown. Who could fail to see it?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Military-grade ECM equipment is deployed throughout the wall. It far exceeds what a normal military facility requires to prevent accidental trespassing.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: It's strange.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: If the First Army is determined to stop cooperating with the legislature...

attributes.content: We'll be spending our entire stay dealing with this equipment, if we don't think of something.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I have some discoveries, or should I say, hypotheses.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: I tried to use my Arts this morning, focusing on specific human signal bands to reduce workload.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: I thought about giving up after several attempts came up empty before I discovered a band that periodically disappears before reappearing.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: It occurs at regular intervals, with two iterations up to this point.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Did you see anything go through the wall?
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.options: But we didn't see what the payload was.

attributes.content: I remember it. The searchlight followed it without setting off any alarms. I thought I was lucky, but it seems strange now that I think of it.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: If the curfew was imposed in order to covertly transport something behind the wall—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: It may be the only way for us to sneak in.

attributes.content: If we want to use it to sneak in, we could lay in wait along its path.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Come back, Doctor. We need to plan our next steps.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: This time, I need to be present.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Doctor!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You said you found an abnormal patient? Is he—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: The doctor shakes her head before Tonya could finish.
You came sooner than I thought, Tonya, but...
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: See for yourself.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: The doctor lifts the quarantine tarp and reveals a body covered by white cloth.
Lifeless like a marble statue.
Then, she lifts the cloth and folds it up...
Tonya's nails dig into her palm. She has seen death plenty of times, but never one as terrible as this...
She sees the familiar face, the soul long gone from it, but not the slightest sign of pain or struggle upon it.
The brow is relaxed, the eyelids closed, the slightly curved lips highlighting the lines of age, freezing everything into what appears to be a benevolent smile.
Then, the neck, the shoulders, the torso... Tonya's eyes go wide.
Bright crystals extrude from the pale skin, reflecting a yellowish glow in the ceiling lamp's light.
No, no, doctor...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: It's not the same as what happened to my sister...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: A quiet sigh answers her in the empty operating room.
The symptoms are indicative of an acute Oripathy onset.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: But he had demonstrated similar symptoms as your sister when he first came. If your sister was in the initial stages, he was in the final stages.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Could the illness be... with Oripathy...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: But people with Oripathy don't die so peacefully!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You're right. Oripathy patients often experience unimaginable pain when they die, as their bodies disintegrate.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I performed a comprehensive check before you came...
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: His vocal cords were not swollen, nor were there any scratch marks on his body. His muscles were relaxed, with no sign of painful spasms prior to death, nor any sign of disintegration...
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: But all these questions do not change the fact that he died from Oripathy.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: This points to the possibility that his condition, and whatever is affecting your sister, is simply a variant of Oripathy.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Tonya was no longer listening. Her ears are ringing, and her eyes refuse to avert their gaze from the smile on the dead's face.
It is neither release from suffering, nor hope for the end, only a numb comfort.
His consciousness, his soul, all his emotions towards the land, even fear itself, have been soothed over by a gentle yet irresistible force.
And the only clue, the last hope to discover the truth about the strange illness, is gone with the patient's passing.
...What's that sound, doctor?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: What sound? I don't hear anything.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I think I hear my sister crying... is she calling to me?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Look at me, Tonya. Your sister is in isolation. I keep my eye on her every day and hum lullabies to put her to bed. She'll be fine.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: She's still sleeping. Children her age need sleep to recover. Whatever you're hearing, it's not her... take a deep breath.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: No, doctor, it's not that...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: It was raining heavily that night. I ran through three streets to bring her to you. She was so light, like an empty basket...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: But her head, pressed against my forehead, was burning, so hot it made my tremble...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I still don't know what she's sick with. It wouldn't even leave me with a speck of hope!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Why did it do this to her, to us...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: What did we do wrong?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Tonya!
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Go—
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: Doctor, we have to go! The soldiers have found this place! They're already downstairs. We'll need to take the emergency passage.
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: What about Nina?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: In the incubator. Should we grab her?
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: ...What's going on with Tonya?
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: Give me a hand and get her up. Nina cannot leave the incubator at this time. We can only pray they'll show mercy to a child.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Leave the rest. We can come back for it.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: So light...
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: What about this one?
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: We have to leave him.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: He might even buy us some time.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Let's go.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I left a sign for the others in the operating room.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Gah... they got away again.
attributes.name: Impatient Soldier

attributes.content: Doesn't matter. Our primary mission is not to arrest people. They always get wind of things, like those 'musbeasts' in the underground layers.
attributes.name: Cautious Soldier

attributes.content: Found anything other than the kid?
attributes.name: Cautious Soldier

attributes.content: No.
attributes.name: Impatient Soldier

attributes.content: Did you search every room thoroughly?
attributes.name: Cautious Soldier

attributes.content: I—
attributes.name: Impatient Soldier

attributes.content: —Found it!
attributes.name: Excited Voice

attributes.content: There's a body in the operating room, but...
attributes.name: Excited Voice

attributes.content: Take it anyway.
attributes.name: Cautious Soldier

attributes.content: Be careful not to knock off any pieces.
attributes.name: Cautious Soldier

attributes.content: I'm taking these meds too.
attributes.name: Impatient Soldier

attributes.content: There's no date on them, who knows if they work at all. But suit yourself.
attributes.name: Cautious Soldier

attributes.content: Better than nothing.
attributes.name: Impatient Soldier

attributes.content: Doing this stuff every day... I don't want to wait for that factory scrip khuinya to get my sleeping pills.
attributes.name: Impatient Soldier

attributes.content: That one again?
Yeah.
Something happened during fresh-air time? Refused to kneel, or—
Offered to take punishment for the others when boss was punishing the Infected.
Again... carry the suka up.
Hey, still breathing?
attributes.name: Grumbling Soldier

attributes.content: Zhopa, they're gonna kill someone if they go on like this.
attributes.name: Grumbling Soldier

attributes.content: The Generalik wants the Infected alive...
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: Tell the tupoi Luzhin to explain to the Generalik. I'm sure he could spin a bunch of flowery words, considering it was the Generalik who stuck him in our squad to begin with.
attributes.name: Grumbling Soldier

attributes.content: Watch your words. Luzhin is our superior officer, for now at least. The First Army's—
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: Honor? Discipline? As if there's any of that left in the First Army. Blyat, screw that svolotsch Generalik...
attributes.name: Grumbling Soldier

attributes.content: Bleh, keep an eye on 'em, and call a medic at any signs of trouble—those pizdets animal doctors do nothing well except clean up dead bodies...
attributes.name: Grumbling Soldier

attributes.content: But I bet this suka will last the night.
attributes.name: Grumbling Soldier

attributes.content: Shouldn't have defied us, eh?
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: I can take it... leave the others alone.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Hey, you asked for it. Don't say we didn't warn you.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: I saw bandages on your arm while you were carrying me, and that wound on your head...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Did you defy your own superior, Ratkov?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Don't push your luck. I'm only here because I was ordered to keep an eye on you. Don't presume to question the Generalik just because we've talked a couple of times.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: Sorry...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: I just happened to see similar marks on you, which made me think... perhaps we're not so different after all.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: The youth fights the pain to take out a packet with blood-stained fingertips, dangling it in front of the soldier with a trembling hand.
What are you doing?
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: For you. Medicine powder made from a plant that grows only on the Northern Tundra. Works wonders on wounds...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: How did we not find it when we searched you?
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: Survival wisdom that Ursus taught us... take it. I have enough for myself.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: I know this medicine.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: I grew up in Zavorsk. One time I got a gaping gash on my leg that almost reached the bone. My grandfather poured this medicine over the wound, and it only took one night for the wound to close.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: My family gave me a bunch when I enlisted. It came in handy in the two years that I spent on the border fighting bandits, before I was transferred to the First Army.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: I didn't expect to see it here.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: Zavorsk... it's near the Far North...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Yes. I haven't heard from my family ever since the Fourth Army's insurrection.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: Most of my companions came from the Northern Tundra.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: If I can meet up with them, I could ask them about your family—
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: There's no need.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: I'm already breaking rules by talking to you like this.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: I have to go. I can put in a request if there's anything you need.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: You said your grandfather used that medicine on you.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: The one who gave me the medicine said that only lumberjacks and hunters who live in the Northern Tundra forests know how to make it.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Your grandfather—
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: He was a lumberjack. So was my father.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: While you joined the First Army. Good...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: I know many children of lumberjacks. At least you aren't learning how to bury other children of lumberjacks.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: The soldier's shoulders twitch, as though he had been whipped.
You know how many soldiers have claimed those forests for themselves, backed by the rich and powerful.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: They beat up and expelled those who lived in the forests, forcing them to leave the land which their ancestor had always lived, becoming homeless refugees, or willing slaves.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: No doubt your father and grandfather will be proud of you, seeing you grow up strong and healthy, escaping such cruel fate with your family...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: What are you trying to say?
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: My question for you is—whose son are you?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Your grandfather, the lumberjack from Zavorsk...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Did he heal your leg so that you can bend it to the oppressors, or stand with dignity like a true son of Ursus?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: I have no requests for you to pass on. I only ask that you remember that you are a child of Ursus, like me, like all of us.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: We will never bow to those who wield the whip. We fight for everyone who should not be whipped.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: If the day comes when you want to find out about your father and grandfather, I... *cough* *cough*—
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Save your strength...
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: I'll pretend I didn't hear any of that. Whatever you wanted to say, save it.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: Wake up, boss.
Mm... what's going on...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Bozhe moi, your wounds... those monsters—!
attributes.name: Miner

attributes.content: Doesn't matter... how did you get out? I thought we were all locked up.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: All the doors got unlocked for some reason.
attributes.name: Miner

attributes.content: We came to find you as soon as we got out. No soldiers along the way. Maybe something's gone wrong. Anyway, it's our chance!
attributes.name: Miner

attributes.content: But can you move? Your injuries—
attributes.name: Miner

attributes.content: Don't worry about me...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: We don't have a lot of time, no matter whatever's happened with the Army. We need to move immediately.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Here, hold onto me.
attributes.name: Miner

attributes.content: Our people are all here... what's going on?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: It's you—
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: I talked to my mates. The guys on duty will leave a gap. You have ten minutes to get out.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: Thank you so much...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Ratkov, If I hear anything about your family—
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Forget it. We all know it's a long shot.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: What will you do? The general will undoubtedly punish you after we leave.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: We will not submit so easily. Anatoliy no longer deserves our loyalty.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: There is considerable discontent towards his behavior in the Army. He will pay for his outrages.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: We've talked enough. Go, and don't waste this chance.
attributes.name: Taciturn Soldier

attributes.content: ...Take care, Ratkov.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: I will remember you, son of a Zavorsk lumberjack.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: <p=1>Zelgrad Underground Safehouse</><p=2> Jan 21, 1102, 17:39</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Hm...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You're awake?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Where are we? Nina—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: The soldiers came to the clinic. We only had time to get you out.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: We couldn't take your sister because she couldn't leave the incubator in her current state. I'm sorry.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Ugh—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Headache? It's normal after blacking out like that.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Is Nina still there? Did they take her? I have to—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I went back to the clinic when you were out cold.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: ...Doctor?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Nina wasn't there. They took her. The good news is that they took the incubator too. The bad news is... we don't know where they took her.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I understand you want to find her, and I'll do what I can to help, but—
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Promise me this, Tonya. You have to stay strong, even if you don't find her... the rest of your family need you. They look up to you.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: You want to know what you can do? There's always one thing, and only one thing—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Find more evidence.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Doctor, you're sure that Kirill had the same symptoms as Nina when he first came into your care, only more serious?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: If you believe me. There was a Cautus who could use healing Arts, who might have eased his pain at my request. No one else came into contact.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: The Oripathy progressed rapidly. And what happened to him doesn't look like the result of pain relief.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Then I must find more evidence... and Nina.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I must find Nina...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: What are you going to do?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: What I had to do.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: <p=1>The Walls, City of Zelgrad</><p=2> Jan 22, 1102, 00:25</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Target lost.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Target has left the surveillance area. Drone acquisition lost.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: That means it's now within one klick of the wall, near your position.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: The patrols have left. There should be a gap of about ten minutes along the road.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I'm coming over, Amiya.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Got it!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Watch out for the searchlights.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Do you see a grey vehicle?
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Not yet!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Wait, I think—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: It's coming.;Approaching from behind on the right side.

attributes.content: I'm not there yet! Wait for me—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: We haven't made a move yet. Stay safe, Closure.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I see it. Looks like a modified Infected tractor for use in the wilderness.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: I've heard of military tractors ending up with the Infected after retirement. Not sure I've ever seen it go the other way.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: We'll have to get closer to find out.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: You'll fall out of comms if you get any closer.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Let's go in and figure it out from there.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Very well. I'll reestablish communications once you're inside.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Raidian out.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Guh...
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: The radio always goes out around these parts. Nothing to do when waiting for the door to open.
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: Didn't they say they were building a new base station? How's the signal still so lousy—
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: ...From this vantage point, we can't even see how the door opens, or what sort of security measures are present.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: We may have to get on the tractor before it gets swarmed by patrols and go inside with it.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: I'm not sure I could make the jump...;It's a little high.

attributes.content: No worries, I got you!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: I think I'll need help too.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I can take Closure too.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Counting on you, Mon3tr.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: (Hushed) Quiet now and stay focused. Wait for my signal.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Why's it taking so long for the door to open today, bratan?
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: Who are you calling bratan? I'm your baba.
attributes.name: Tired Soldier

attributes.content: You'll wait if you want to go in. They're still checking your creds.
attributes.name: Tired Soldier

attributes.content: Wasn't you here last night, baba.
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: Yeah, they reassigned everybody to the suburban factories. We're on three shifts a day now, don't even get to sleep.
attributes.name: Tired Soldier

attributes.content: Alright, you can go in—
attributes.name: Tired Soldier

attributes.content: *cough*—*cough*!
attributes.name: Tired Soldier

attributes.content: What's that—
attributes.name: Tired Soldier

attributes.content: ...Woah, we got a lunatic trying to attack the wall!
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: Attack on the wall! Need backup at Zone A! Repeat, need backup at Zone A!
attributes.name: Tired Soldier

attributes.content: There was an explosion, someone's trying to force their way through—
attributes.name: Tired Soldier

attributes.content: There's someone else here? Did we luck into unexpected help?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: No time to think about it now!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Raidian has rendezvoused with us. Let's use the chaos to get on the tractor—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: —Close the door! No one gets in!
attributes.name: Stern Soldier

attributes.content: Attention—
attributes.name: Stern Soldier

attributes.content: Crossbows ready!
attributes.name: Stern Soldier

attributes.content: W-Wait! Don't point those weapons at me! I'm just delivering stuff!
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: Ugh, I'm gonna miss my next stop—
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: Hold it!
attributes.name: Stern Soldier

attributes.content: I'm sorry, I-I really can't afford to be late!
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: Looks like a twenty-four-man squad with potential reinforcements coming up. We need to get moving.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: (Whispers) Come, Doctor!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Doctor! Give me your hand!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: —That one's trying to get inside! Fire!
attributes.name: Stern Soldier

attributes.content: For an instant, your cries seem to be drowned in the noise.
Before your hands grasp anything in the darkness, you see a somewhat familiar figure in protective gear run towards you.
Stand firm.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: The figure charges at you and lifts you up, until you manage to find Mon3tr's hand and get on the edge of the tractor.
Then it disappears before you have time to react.
You turn around to see the figure in protective gear clumsily trying to climb the tractor, only to fall back onto the ground—
Easy prey for the soldiers rushing in from a distance, crossbows raised.
Look out—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure—
attributes.name: Amiya
